conditions: The passage concerns implementation-tool material at the start of the file carrying a module, as described in §4.2.
limitations: The applicability is MS-VBAL revision 2.4, dated May 20, 2025. Specific Office application behavior, earlier and later revisions, and other Visual Basic lineages require separate evidence.
The scope excludes Begin/End appearing elsewhere, the grammar of generated module attributes, an Office serialization guarantee and the host application object model.

triggers: Publisher correction, digest mismatch, a revised language edition, or contrary clause evidence.

statement: MS-VBAL 2.4 separates the VBA module body from the implementation-generated version marker and leading Begin/End export material. That export material is outside the module body and does not have to conform to the VBA grammar.
